title: Subnet Mask & Network Address
statement: Given an IPv4 address and a prefix length (CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.50/24), compute the Network Address and the Broadcast Address in standard dotted-decimal notation.
input_format: A single string in the format A.B.C.D/M where 0 <= A,B,C,D <= 255 and 1 <= M <= 32.
output_format:
Print two lines:
Network: A.B.C.D
Broadcast: A.B.C.D
